# Xiaomi MiTV-AESP0 (codename aquaman), Android TV 9 (SDK 28), firmware PI.2055.
# Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (disabled by launcher/build-and-install.sh).
# Live TV app: none (no tuner/HDMI inputs); com.google.android.tv is Live Channels.
#
# Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/xiaomi-mitv-aesp0/debloat.txt
# Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/xiaomi-mitv-aesp0/debloat.txt
# Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.
#
# Notes from this firmware:
# - Default IME is already Gboard, so the Mi TV 4A missing-keyboard quirk doesn't apply.
# - The remote's Home button sends KEYCODE_ALL_APPS (284), not HOME. Android 9 sends that key only
#   to the system launcher, so with tvlauncher disabled Home does nothing. Fix: install with
#     HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1 TV_HOST=<tv ip> launcher/build-and-install.sh
#   which enables the launcher's HomeKeyService. Android switches it off on every reinstall,
#   so always pass HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1.
#   `input keyevent 284` over adb skips the accessibility filter; test with the real remote.
# - No HDMI/AV inputs: the launcher hides its Inputs pill by itself on this stick.
# - Kept on this set: voice assistant (katniss/pumpkin), Chromecast (mediashell),
#   Mi Cast (com.mitv.milinkservice) and firmware updates (com.xiaomi.mitv.updateservice).
#
# Second verified set (Indonesia-region unit, same firmware PI.2055, in daily use since
# 21 Oct 2026 with Netflix / Jellyfin / SmartTube / Vidio): the groups marked
# "second set" below are disabled on that stick on top of the original list.
# Region note: the ID unit has only the misspelled autoinstalls package below, and
# none of the preloaded apps in the original list (DAZN, Red Bull TV, Duo, TCL browser).

# Xiaomi + Google telemetry
com.miui.tv.analytics
com.google.android.feedback
com.google.android.tv.bugreportsender
tv.alphonso.alphonso_eula                   # Alphonso automatic content recognition (viewing tracking)

# PatchWall, content rows, sponsored rows
com.mitv.tvhome.atv
com.mitv.tvhome.michannel
com.xm.webcontent
com.google.android.tvrecommendations
android.autoinstalls.config.xiaomi.mibox3   # Play auto-install of partner apps
android.autoinstalls.config.xioami.mibox3   # same, misspelled duplicate (sic, "xioami")

# Preloaded apps
com.dazn
com.nousguide.android.rbtv                  # Red Bull TV
com.google.android.apps.tachyon             # Google Duo
com.google.android.play.games
com.tcl.browser

# Xiaomi services (second set)
mitv.service                                # MiTV service framework for the rows removed above
com.mitv.download.service                   # PatchWall download service
com.mitv.videoplayer                        # stock Mi video player; comment out if you use it
com.xiaomi.android.tvsetup.partnercustomizer  # partner customisation that seeds partner apps at setup

# Xiaomi services (second set, optional — the original set keeps these)
# com.xiaomi.mitv.updateservice             # firmware updates; the original set keeps it, uncomment to stop OTAs
# com.mitv.milinkservice                    # Mi Cast receiver; the original set keeps it, uncomment if you never cast

# Google TV plumbing this stick does not need (second set)
com.google.android.tv                       # Live Channels; the stick has no tuner or HDMI input
# (com.android.providers.tv, the TV content provider, stays enabled: the repo never disables it)
com.google.android.videos                   # Google Play Movies & TV
com.google.android.youtube.tvmusic         # YouTube Music TV
com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith     # setup wizard: gives Home back, costs casting (comment out to keep casting)
com.google.android.partnersetup
com.google.android.onetimeinitializer
com.android.onetimeinitializer

# Accounts, backup and printing plumbing (second set; nothing on a TV uses these)
com.android.providers.contacts
com.android.providers.calendar
com.google.android.syncadapters.contacts
com.google.android.syncadapters.calendar
com.google.android.backuptransport

com.android.sharedstoragebackup
com.android.wallpaperbackup
com.android.printspooler
# com.android.companiondevicemanager        # kept: Bluetooth companion pairing, no list on main disables it
com.android.settings.intelligence
com.android.se                              # secure element; the stick has no NFC
com.android.cts.ctsshim                     # CTS test shims, not user features
com.android.cts.priv.ctsshim

# Screensavers (second set; that stick runs always-on with its own home screen)
com.google.android.backdrop
com.android.dreams.basic
com.mitv.dream

# Voice, accessibility, phone remote (second set, optional; the original set keeps voice, so these stay
# commented out here: uncomment the ones you don't use)
# com.google.android.katniss                # voice search; the voice stack barely works on this firmware
# com.google.android.speech.pumpkin
# com.google.android.tts                    # text-to-speech; keep it if anything reads text aloud
# com.google.android.marvin.talkback        # accessibility; only disable if nobody uses TalkBack
# com.google.android.tv.remote.service      # kept enabled: phone-as-remote and the remote's mic bridge
